decision_rule: Columns: the first-visit Solver answers of arm b-w4 (B), the twin t-twin (T) and the delivering arm a-agree (A), each rendered through the delivered row's deliver normaliser and projection (AT1 self-check) and scored ONCE as a complete column with slurp-slu-official-train (stage3_rollout_score.py --mode supply-variants), paired by row (sample_id), 10,000 draws, seed 20260928. THE NULL: T minus A on official pooled SLU-F1 and intent accuracy; its bar is |T - A delta| + the T - A CI95 half-width (the same law as the cross-flight in-chain A/A), never below the provisional floor 0.3163 pp SLU-F1 (the ROLL-AA anchor 0.735 pp at n = 200 scaled to n = 1,080, scripts/checks/stage3_effect_floor_check.py). INSTRUMENT FAULT (no verdict): the T - A CI95 excludes zero on either metric. NOMINATED (the claim ceiling; Q6 ruling): the B - A official pooled SLU-F1 delta exceeds the bar AND its CI95 lower bound is above zero AND the B - A intent CI95 upper bound is not below zero (the guard: no measured intent loss). HARMFUL: the B - A CI95 upper bound below zero on either metric. Otherwise NOT NOMINATED (width). A nomination only sends the composed policy to a full-system read against an in-chain A/A; it is never an admission and never a system-level claim. Every verdict carries the per-scenario table in both weightings and the per-type exact TP/FP/FN of the 19 revised types, B vs A and T vs A.
estimand: ESTIMAND CAVEAT. The expectation is transferred from cell W4's CROSS-FLIGHT full-system read (docs/results/2026-09-28-slurp-w4-fold-a-read.md: official pooled SLU-F1 +0.79 pp CI95 [-0.56, +2.12] against the shared wave A/A). In that flight the W4 cards reached EVERY node whose request carries the slot-contract supply: the realised prompt tokens rose +1,207.8 per Solver, +1,207.4 per Reviewer and +1,201.9 per Planner contact (the registration had projected +724.5 per Solver contact). Here only arm b-w4's FIRST Solver request carries them: the Reviewer, the Planner and the Solver revisit see the AGREE v2 cards and never see an arm's output. B minus A is therefore the Solver-local first-visit effect of the W4 cards, a DIFFERENT estimand from the +0.79 pp system effect (which also includes the Reviewer and Planner reading the conventions and any revision they drive); 0.79 pp is declared only as the size to look for, not as the value this read should reproduce.

fit_estimate.method: tokens_per_supplied_item = ceil(max over every Solver contact of both sealed flights of realised prompt_tokens / supplied items) -- the per-item envelope through the origin (the OLS slope, reported beside it, has no positive envelope intercept); base_prompt_tokens = max(1, ceil(max of prompt_tokens - tokens_per_supplied_item * items)); max_supplied_items = the structural sum of the supply caps that can reach the Solver (never exceeded by construction)
